svg.data-spec:
title: Control plane API kind: flow dir: down
[Clients] gray right cli: funcdctl sdk: SDK | pkg/sdk http: HTTP | any client [/]
[Control plane API] blue authn: Token known? | bearer or X-Api-Key rbac: RBAC allows? | verb, kind, namespace r401: 401 Unauthorized @red r403: 403 Forbidden @red [Operations] blue other: Other operations | retry, backup, hold logs: Logs | Functions, runs res: Resources | all kinds dlq: Dead letters | replay, delete [/] [/]
[Storage layer] coral right meta: Metastore @db evstore: Event store @db [/]
flogs: Function logs | files in Blob @green ctl: Controller | watch, then reconcile @green
Clients > authn authn > rbac: yes authn > r401: no rbac > Operations: allow rbac > r403: deny res > meta dlq > evstore logs > flogs meta ~> ctl: watch event
